channel.description: 每日精選時事、商業、股市、宇宙、科技話題

item.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
item.description: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.

item.description: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

item.description: Panic fueling the selloff of Nvidia, Broadcom and other tech giants is overblown.

item.title: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
item.description: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

item.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
item.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

item.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
item.description: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

item.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
item.description: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

item.title: Where was my invite to the — wait, what? Airbnb had a gala?
item.description: Airbnb’s nonprofit held its inaugural gala on Wednesday in Los Angeles, and the internet had one reaction — the *what* gala?

item.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
item.description: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

item.title: The R2 SUV is already Rivian’s best-selling vehicle
item.description: Rivian is seeing strong enough sales of the new EV that it improved its guidance to Wall Street for the second time this year.

item.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
item.description: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

item.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
item.description: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

item.title: Fan-fiction site Archive of Our Own (AO3) could be offline for up to 4 weeks after security incident
item.description: The site has such a passionate user base that, within two hours of the announcement, its status page's posts had garnered millions of views (and much panicked commentary) across social media.

item.title: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
item.description: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.

item.title: Amazon reported booming cloud revenue but otherwise missed expectations
item.description: The biggest ouch of the report was its negative free cash flow of $2.4 billion.

item.title: Elon Musk is ‘truly a genius,’ says Vladimir Putin
item.description: Putin said that he and Musk are in "close contact" about Rassvet, Russia's Starlink-like satellite connectivity project.

item.title: Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto
item.description: Some estimates say hackers stole billions in crypto from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, during a cyberattack on Thursday.

item.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
item.description: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

item.title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’
item.description: The success of blockbuster hits like Project Hail Mary and Verity is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.

item.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
item.description: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.
